_help: AutoStack Quick Class. One entry per class, keyed by classId. To add a class: copy the income-tracker entry, give it a new key, fill it in, set status to ready, run npm run build. status: draft = built only in the draft preview (npm run dev -- --drafts). ready = live, and needs youtubeVideoId and ctaUrl. ctaUrl can be a full URL or site:<key> from config/site.json. Offer text can use {price_now} and {guarantee_days} from config/starter-kit.json, so the price is only typed in one place.

income-tracker.title: Income Tracker
income-tracker.headline: How to turn scattered bank alerts into one clean profit dashboard
income-tracker.subhead: Customers pay you by transfer, and at month-end you still guess where the money went. In this class I show you how AI reads your bank alerts, puts every transfer in Google Sheets, and shows what you made on one screen. No coding.
income-tracker.forWhom: For business owners who get bank alerts and want to track their expenses automatically.
learn: Your records already exist. Your bank emails you every credit and debit alert. I show you how AI reads them, so you stop typing transfers at midnight.
Three numbers is all you need: money in, money out, and what is left. No accounting words.
A full month of transfers turning into a clean Google Sheet, step by step.
Zero coding. If you can copy and paste, you can do this.

preview._help: Optional picture or phone recording of the result, shown on the registration page. video is a short silent mp4 (H.264), src is its poster image. With no video, src alone is shown as a picture. Leave both empty to hide it.
preview.alt: A phone recording of the Income Tracker dashboard showing money in, money out and what is left.
preview.caption: Money in, money out and what is left, on one screen.

faq.question: Do I have to buy the kit to use what you showed?
faq.answer: No. You can build it yourself from the class. The kit saves you the setup time, and you get help when you get stuck.

faq.question: I am not technical. Can I still do this?
faq.answer: Yes. 35 of the 36 setups need no code, and every step is written out so you can follow along.

faq.question: What if it will not connect?
faq.answer: Bring your screen to AutoStack Live on the weekend, or ask in the community. If we still cannot get it working, the guarantee gives you your money back.

faq.question: How do I get it after paying?
faq.answer: Selar emails you the link to the kit and your community invite right after payment.
